test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an indirect tax?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goods and Services Tax**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indirect tax -

 
 
• The tax which is not taken directly from the public but reaches the government indirectly is called indirect tax.
 
• Indirect taxes are excise duties on goods manufactured in the country, customs duties on goods to be imported or exported.
 
• E.g. Service Tax, Central Excise Duty, Customs Duty, etc__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The tax levied on all services is called Service Tax.
 
• The tax levied on the sale of goods under indirect tax is called sales tax.
 
• The tax levied on the products made in the country is called Excise Duty.
 
• Types of Indirect Taxes -
 
 
• Sales Tax
 
• Service Tax
 
• Excise Duty
 
• Professional Tax
 
• Dividend Distribution Tax
 
• Entertainment Tax
 
• Property Tax
 
• Stamp Duty
 
• VAT Tax (VAT)
 
• Toll Tax
